en.headline: Tang says Huanggang systems still being tuned, border hours under talks
en.dek: The security chief said computer and camera adjustments are under way at the rebuilt port, and Hong Kong is discussing longer land-crossing hours with the mainland.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the rebuilt Huanggang Port is still having its computer systems adjusted after large-scale drills, as the government works towards an opening in the fourth quarter.

Speaking on a Now TV programme, Tang said overall operations in the drills had been smooth, but cameras used for facial recognition and other equipment on the new five-in-one vehicle lanes needed fine-tuning so clearance stayed both orderly and efficient. The Policy Address said the port would adopt co-location and a single joint inspection, with a designed daily capacity of 200,000 passenger trips, up from about 50,000 at the old crossing.

Hong Kong's first five-year plan also calls for longer opening hours at land boundary control points. Tang said talks with mainland counterparts were under way. He cited Shenzhen Bay, which already runs 24 hours on some special dates such as New Year's Eve, and asked whether that window could be widened, and Heung Yuen Wai, which now opens from 7am to 10pm. Some cross-boundary students wanted an earlier start, he said, while others found the 10pm close too early after dinner.
Tang said both sides shared the aim of making travel more convenient where that was practicable. He did not announce a confirmed opening date for the new Huanggang Port.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：新皇崗口岸仍在調校系統 正商延長陸路通關
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示演練整體暢順，人面識別鏡頭及五合一車道仍須微調；陸路口岸延長服務時間正與內地商討。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，重建後的皇崗口岸在大型演練後仍在調校電腦系統，政府正爭取於今年第四季投入服務。
鄧炳強接受Now新聞台節目訪問時說，測試整體運作暢順，但新口岸設有大量過關設備及五合一車道，部分用作人面識別的鏡頭位置仍要微調，以確保暢順同時達到最佳效率。施政報告指口岸將實施一地兩檢及「合作查驗、一次放行」，設計每日可處理20萬人次，高於舊口岸約5萬人次。
本港首份五年規劃提出爭取延長陸地口岸通關時間。鄧炳強說正與內地部門商討，例如深圳灣在除夕等特別日子已通宵開放，是否有空間擴闊；蓮塘香園圍現時早上7時至晚上10時運作，有跨境學童希望更早開關，亦有市民覺得10時關閘偏早。
他表示兩地目標一致，希望在可行情況下盡量便利往來。他未有公布新皇崗口岸的確實開通日期。
